Context: 6. Proceedings after Retirement

3. (ii) 'Encashment of leave' on retirement. The Competent Authority can withhold whole or part of cash equivalent of leave salary if, in its opinion, there is a possibility of some money becoming due from the employee on conclusion of the proceedings. On conclusion of the proceedings, the amount so withheld may be paid after adjustment of Government dues, if any.  
- Rule 39 (3), CCS (Leave) Rules.  
- Rule 63 (5).  
- Rule 4, CCS (CP) Rules;
